Project Vision:
### Project Vision

Imagine a world where healthcare is not just accessible but also intuitive, efficient, and secure. Our groundbreaking digital platform is set to revolutionize patient-doctor interactions by leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies. Envision a Progressive Web App (PWA) that seamlessly connects patients and doctors, offering real-time, AI-driven consultations and insights. 

For patients, this means a user-friendly interface where they can effortlessly interact with an AI agent for onboarding, consultations, and general inquiries. This AI not only understands and responds but also summarizes conversations, providing valuable health insights. Imagine having your medical history, consultation summaries, and AI-generated health reports at your fingertips, anytime, anywhere.

For doctors, our platform is a game-changer. It offers a comprehensive dashboard to manage patient interactions, access detailed medical histories, and receive AI-assisted consultation summaries. The AI integration ensures that doctors can make informed decisions swiftly, enhancing the quality of care they provide.

Security is paramount; our platform complies with stringent Canadian and Quebec Loi 25 laws, ensuring that all patient data is encrypted and secure. Hosted on AWS and powered by MongoDB, our platform is both scalable and reliable.

Join us in transforming healthcare into a more connected, intelligent, and secure experience. Welcome to the future of patient-doctor interactions.

Revenue Models.Rationale: Patients would pay a recurring fee for access to the platform's services, including AI-driven onboarding, consultation summaries, and historical data management. This model ensures a steady revenue stream and allows patients to benefit from continuous access to the platform's features. The revenue is received by the platform provider.

Doctors would pay a recurring fee for access to advanced features such as AI-assisted consultation tools, patient management, and real-time conversation analysis. This model provides a consistent revenue stream and ensures that doctors have ongoing access to the platform's capabilities. The revenue is received by the platform provider.

The AI system could generate revenue through a commission-based model where a percentage of the subscription fees from patients and doctors is allocated to cover the costs of AI services and maintenance. This ensures that the AI system is financially supported while aligning its revenue with the platform's overall income. The revenue is received by the AI service provider, such as OpenAI.
